sources.name: Hugging Face model card
sources.notes: Vendor's own model card / README. PRIMARY source of truth for reported scores.

sources.name: Official tech report / arXiv paper
sources.notes: Peer-style technical report. Tied with model card as primary; cross-check numbers.

sources.name: Artificial Analysis
sources.notes: Independently-reproduced benchmark scores (AA-LCR, τ³-bench, etc.). Fills gaps; its eval settings may differ from the vendor's. The AA Intelligence Index is not tracked. Newest models often only carry AA's newer index evals (AA-Briefcase, AA-Omniscience, Terminal-Bench Science, …) and have no GPQA/MMLU-Pro/AIME numbers yet — check /models/<slug> and record the absence in gaps.

sources.name: Vendor blog / official announcement
sources.notes: Official company blog or launch page.

sources.name: Another vendor's comparison table
sources.notes: Benchmark table on a different vendor's model card that lists this model under the same harness. Not the model's own card: usable to fill a column, always record the table's URL and say so in the score's notes.

sources.name: LMArena (formerly Chatbot Arena)
sources.notes: Crowdsourced Elo / Arena score. Treat as a distinct benchmark, not a check on others.

sources.name: Other reputable website
sources.notes: Catch-all for a reputable non-listed source; always record source_url.
